say:1:1230419001:1.text: I just want to scream. I don't care if the sea hears me or not.
say:1:1230419001:1.source_cn: 俺只是自己想喊，管大海弄啥？
say:1:1230419001:1.male: I just want to scream. I don't care if the sea hears me or not.
say:1:1230419001:1.female: I just want to scream. I don't care if the sea hears me or not.

say:2:1230419002:1.text: Whenever I'm at the beach alone, I think of my man.
say:2:1230419002:1.source_cn: 每次俺一个人看海，就会想起俺家男人。
say:2:1230419002:1.male: Whenever I'm at the beach alone, I think of my man.
say:2:1230419002:1.female: Whenever I'm at the beach alone, I think of my man.

say:3:1230419003:1.text: This is a taboo in our village since many of us have lost our men to the sea.
say:3:1230419003:1.source_cn: 在村里俺不能提这个，因为很多姐姐妹妹的男人也是海里没的。
say:3:1230419003:1.male: This is a taboo in our village since many of us have lost our men to the sea.
say:3:1230419003:1.female: This is a taboo in our village since many of us have lost our men to the sea.

say:4:1230419004:1.text: So, I'll shout at the sea when I'm alone at the beach.
say:4:1230419004:1.source_cn: 所以俺自己一个人看海时，就对着海喊一喊。
say:4:1230419004:1.male: So, I'll shout at the sea when I'm alone at the beach.
say:4:1230419004:1.female: So, I'll shout at the sea when I'm alone at the beach.
